title: Reading Part 1: What to do in and around Boston (USA)
source: MSA Berlin 2023 Englisch, Reading Part 1; Texte leicht bereinigt
body:
**The people**

- **Vanessa** loves the seaside location of Boston. That's why she would like to see the city from there. Enjoying a great nightly sightseeing trip would be a perfect start for her weekend trip. But she is also here for the rich cultural heritage of the East Coast. Since she doesn't have much time, she would take a tour that offers as many different places of cultural interest as possible in one day.
- **Ethan's** kids have already warned him that they won't go on another one of these guided sightseeing bus tours. Instead they want to be active. So he needs an activity that is fun and allows his family to get away from the crowds. If his partner takes the kids, he would also love to do something on his own. It would be great to improve his photography skills with the help of a professional for example.
- **Aubrey's** motto is: pics or it didn't happen. So she wants to go on a tour that helps her remember Boston through the lens of her camera – with her in the center. And later perhaps she can even upload pictures of some hidden places. Exploring Boston at night could also be interesting. She is looking for a tour where she can hear stories about the mysterious side of the city.
- For **Kayla** getting to know a city starts with learning about its past. She would love to go on a tour offering exactly that but which is also interesting for her two younger children. For a second tour, she would like to treat herself to a whole day full of good food and beautiful sights which she can take pictures of. She hopes her followers will "like" them.
- **Alessandro** and his soccer team are in Boston for the first time. First and foremost they want to experience the athletic and fun part of the city. So for a start they think of any activity that could prove a physical challenge for them. Later there should be no holding back on the dance floor if there is any tour that fits.

**The activities**

- **A) Boston Odyssey Dinner Tour**: Try a unique alternative to a typical night out in downtown Boston with an exciting 3-course dinner cruise along the city's waterfront. This 3-hour expedition on Boston Harbor features a three-course meal with live entertainment and dancing. Watch the sun set, then take a stroll under the stars and enjoy the view of the illuminated Boston skyline at night or head to the dance floor for music and fun in the ship's nightclub. Bring that special someone or a whole group of friends for a night to remember.
- **B) Photography Walking Tour**: Follow a friendly professional photographer guide through one of the most exclusive Boston neighborhoods – Beacon Hill. Enjoy historical commentary on many of the houses as you navigate walkways between key landmarks. On the way learn how to capture amazing pictures in less than two hours. Your guide will share tips for how to get the best angle and perspective on the camera or phone of your choice. There is no experience necessary and you will head home with incredible images that capture this leisurely adventure.
- **C) Ghost and Gravestone Tour**: Hop aboard the "Trolley of the Doomed" and unveil the haunted side of Boston on this alternative evening tour of the city's spookiest corners. Led by a costumed host, this tour dives into the haunted history of the city by visiting two of the oldest burying grounds in Boston. The guide's narration not only entertains but also reveals intriguing historical details about the city's dark past. Historic attractions and ghost tales create an entertaining and educational mix. But be aware that parental guidance is recommended for children under 13, as there are stories of murder and mayhem that may not be appropriate for young children.
- **D) Museums Tour**: If you love museums, art, and culture then this tour in the Boston area takes you to some of the country's best! You will stop and see Stockbridge, Massachusetts which is the setting for most of famed artist Norman Rockwell's famous paintings. You will then travel to Springfield Massachusetts to see four more great locations in one, including a botanical garden, an American novelist's museum (Dr. Seuss), a sculptor's exhibition and last but not least The Mark Twain House and Museum. You will have your very own personal photographer, transportation, and tour guide for this all-day outing!
- **E) Boston Instagram Tour**: The Boston Instagram Tour will take you to the most Instagrammable spots in Boston all in one day. If you are looking for some history, delicious food and a ton of great photos, then this is the tour for you! The morning will start with a private pickup directly from your hotel by one of our friendly, local guides. From there your tour will begin as you start your drive in one of our comfortable, spacious and air-conditioned vehicles. This full-day tour will be fully packed with famous landmarks, vintage architecture, secretly located spots and much much more!
- **F) Boston Tea Party Tour**: At the Boston Tea Party Ships and Museum, you can be a part of the famous event that started the course of independence of the USA from Great Britain! This floating museum is unlike anything you've ever experienced before. Live actors, high-tech, interactive exhibits, and authentically restored tea ships are just a taste of what you'll see, hear and feel. Meet the colonists, explore the ships and dump tea overboard just as the Sons of Liberty did on that fateful night of December 16, 1773. It's educational, entertaining and enlightening – an experience not to be missed by adults and especially children of all ages.
- **G) Skyline and Sunset Kayak Tour**: Rent a canoe or kayak and set out on the Charles River for the day. Lessons are available for those looking to learn the ins and outs of canoeing or kayaking, but for those just looking for a little recreation on the river, rentals will do just fine. Setting out from the banks of the Charles our guides can lead you in either direction to take in the view of Boston and Cambridge from this famous waterway. A leisurely way to spend the day with your family, we offer group or individual tours. Families are encouraged to enjoy with children, and those aged 8 and up can even operate their own kayak.
